title_o: When does between-sequence phonological similarity promote irrelevant sound disruption?
verdict_reason: replication_marsh.sav has TASK and the three recall cells for 118 participants; the Sound x Task mixed-ANOVA interaction gives p=.1986 and partial eta^2 .0138 (table .014), matching.

key_test.test: mixed ANOVA, within SOUND (quiet/dissimilar/similar) x between TASK (free/serial), interaction F

obstacles: getOSFfile() is sourced from http://sachaepskamp.com/files/OSF/getOSFfile.R (external, not run); script not runnable offline as written
the script's own effect-size line computes a within-stratum eta^2 (~.011), not the partial eta^2 (.014) the table carries
